evidence_caveat: Java-simulator evidence for the VO front end is nearer T1 than T2: SimulatorPhysics renders one static aerial photo under a planar-homography model, the same model the stitching estimator assumes, so this dataset exercises the estimator against imagery generated by its own modelling assumptions, not independent imagery. Genuine T2 for control and mission behaviour (research_log.md, 2026-08-10).

metrics.name: ate_rmse
metrics.demonstrates: trajectory shape fidelity after removal of unobservable gauge freedoms (global position, heading, scale); not metric accuracy

metrics.name: ate_rmse_normalised
metrics.demonstrates: ATE RMSE normalised by ground-truth path length, so the non-metric estimator scale stays interpretable

metrics.name: drift_per_distance
metrics.demonstrates: rate at which position error grows with distance actually travelled (path length, not displacement); a growth rate, not an aggregate dispersion figure

metrics.name: endpoint_error
metrics.demonstrates: position error at the final evaluated frame, after global alignment

metrics.name: endpoint_error_closed_loop
metrics.demonstrates: final position vs. the physically known launch point of a closed-loop flight

metrics.name: rpe_5m
metrics.demonstrates: relative pose error over a fixed sub-trajectory length, under the single global fitted scale (FR-067)

metrics.name: yaw_rmse

metrics.name: yaw_drift
metrics.demonstrates: rate of yaw-error growth over elapsed processing time

metrics.name: rpe_5m_diagnostic_per_segment_rescaled
metrics.demonstrates: shape fidelity over the same sub-trajectory length with LOCAL scale drift removed by a fresh per-segment fit -- NOT a primary error figure (FR-067)

metrics.name: rpe_5m_scale_drift_contribution
metrics.demonstrates: difference between global-scale and per-segment-rescaled RPE at this length -- the scale-drift contribution to error (FR-067's last sentence)
